standing: Six comparable posts. A working guide, not a rule.
lines: The best post of the week opened on the named study and what it found, in one complete sentence with its number: 4,545 impressions against 81 to 910 for the others.
Open on the named body or study and the finding. Not on a line about the debate, not on a scene, not on our product.
Second paragraph: the gap between the headline version and what the source says. The top three posts all did this.
Then the limits the source itself names, in plain words.
Close on a question that asks what the reader would measure, count or do. It drew 18 comments. A question about their own family drew none.
Short can win. The best post was five sentences and a question. Do not pad to reach a length.
A post written for head teachers belongs to the schools account. Do not write one for Justin's own profile.
